title: Técnico de Transmissão
description:
Descrição

Estamos bucando Técnico de Transmissão que será responsável por realizar atividades relacionadas à instalação, manutenção preventiva e corretiva de equipamentos audiovisuais e sistemas de transmissão (rádio e TV), incluindo atuação direta em torres de retransmissão. Este profissional deve estar apto a realizar trabalhos em altura e garantir o funcionamento contínuo e seguro dos sistemas de transmissão, respeitando os padrões de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Realizar inspeções técnicas nos equipamentos de transmissão, identificando e propondo ações preventivas e corretivas.
  • Executar projetos, instalação e manutenção de equipamentos para transmissão, recepção e retransmissão de sinais de rádio FM e televisão (analógica e digital), inclusive em unidades móveis e torres de transmissão.
  • Realizar testes de funcionamento em campo, laboratório ou nos fabricantes.
  • Efetuar configurações, ajustes e calibrações de equipamentos de transmissão e recepção.
  • Elaborar diagramas técnicos de instalação e auxiliar no levantamento de necessidades para novos projetos.
  • Documentar todas as atividades realizadas em formulários de ocorrência, registrando falhas, soluções aplicadas e peças utilizadas, garantindo rastreabilidade e facilitando manutenções futuras.
  • Solicitar peças, materiais e suporte técnico a fornecedores, conforme autorização do superior imediato.
  • Prestar suporte e orientação técnica às áreas internas da empresa e a técnicos juniores.
  • Instalar enlaces de micro-ondas conforme projetos técnicos e necessidades operacionais.
  • Atender e registrar reclamações de telespectadores, identificando possíveis falhas em retransmissores e reportando à supervisão.
  • Realizar o recebimento de equipamentos, conferência de acessórios, inserção de etiqueta patrimonial e cadastro no sistema da empresa.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Curso técnico completo em Eletrônica, Telecomunicações, Eletrotécnica ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência em manutenção e operação de sistemas de transmissão de rádio e TV.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas analógicos e digitais de transmissão.
  • Conhecimento em enlaces de micro-ondas.
  • Habilidade para leitura e interpretação de diagramas técnicos.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhos em altura (NR-35) e em regime de escala.
  • Boa capacidade de organização e documentação técnica.

Por aqui, temos o #VivoBemEstar, que estimula o nosso time a ter hábitos saudáveis e mais qualidade de vida! Disponibilizados aos nossos colaboradores consultas com nutricionista, psicólogos, serviço social, telemedicina, e muito mais!

Somos uma empresa do Grupo Telefônica, líder em telecomunicações no Brasil. Trabalhamos com o propósito de Digitalizar para Aproximar pessoas, negócios e toda sociedade, construindo uma nação mais conectada e transformando a vida dos brasileiros. Acreditamos que a diversidade de pessoas, vivência, culturas, comportamentos, habilidades e atitudes é um diferencial, que reflete a sociedade em que vivemos. Temos um sólido programa interno, pautados nos pilares de Gênero, LGBTI+, Raça, PcD e 50+ para assegurar uma cultura mais inclusiva e um ambiente mais diverso e representativo. Somos uma empresa de tecnologia, inspirada na diversidade e na inovação, que oferece espaço para todos, apoia e acolhe as diferenças.

Acreditamos que o caminho para oferecer a melhor experiência ao nosso cliente começa pela boa experiência do nosso colaborador.

title: Coordenador(a) de CAD e Auditoria
description:
Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, com atuação de mais de 80 anos. O hospital conta com infraestrutura de alta complexidade e atende mais de 66 especialidades, com certificações ONA 3 e JCI em 2025. A consolidação regional incluiu a Casa de Saúde Campinas e a operadora Vera Cruz (atualmente 2Care); a Rede Hospital Care visa ser a melhor rede de prestadores de saúde privada do Brasil, presente em São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Delegar e coordenar o desenvolvimento das atividades da Auditoria Interna e CAD, visando garantir a eficácia do trabalho realizado
  • Colaborar com os responsáveis dos diversos setores de enfermagem na resolução de problemas técnicos e administrativos referentes aos prontuários médicos, contas hospitalares e processos de trabalho assistenciais
  • Supervisionar a análise de contas hospitalares realizadas pelos membros da equipe e a resolução de não conformidades nos prontuários dos pacientes
  • Supervisionar o agendamento das auditorias externas no setor, de acordo com cronogramas preestabelecidos pelos convênios, bem como o atendimento aos auditores dos convênios
  • Supervisionar o agendamento das datas de fechamentos de altas administrativas, visando enviar parciais da conta aos convênios, periodicamente

  • Acompanhar as legislações e atualizações referentes aos convênios e inerentes à área de atuação

  • Resolver problemas referentes a conflitos no atendimento em geral, fornecendo informações, orientando e direcionando os problemas aos setores competentes
  • Garantir o dimensionamento de pessoal adequado nos setores sob sua responsabilidade, elaborando, coordenando e revisando as escalas de serviço, folgas e férias, visando assegurar o número adequado de colaboradores
  • Supervisionar a equipe nas questões referentes ao arquivamento de prontuários, fornecimento de informações e cópias dos atendimentos prestados, visando garantir a segurança das informações
  • Atuar junto à Comissão de Padronização de Artigos Médico Hospitalares (COPAMH), participando da análise para aquisição de novos produtos, solicitando orçamentos e analisando o custo-benefício, visando avaliar a viabilidade de aquisição e padronização
  • Solicitar orientações do departamento jurídico do hospital nas situações de maior complexidade
  • Realizar a avaliação de desempenho dos colaboradores do setor e daqueles em período de experiência, visando diagnosticar e analisar o desempenho, promovendo o crescimento pessoal e profissional
  • Supervisionar a equipe no atendimento aos clientes internos e externos, solucionando eventuais dúvidas, problemas ou conflitos, com foco nas necessidades dos mesmos e seguindo a legislação vigente
  • Elaborar e reavaliar os manuais de normas e rotinas internas, visando garantir o cumprimento das mesmas e a padronização dos serviços
  • Promover e acompanhar treinamentos aos membros da equipe e integrar os mesmos, visando desenvolver os colaboradores, de acordo com padrões e protocolos do Hospital. Responder pelo fechamento do cartão ponto, regularizar as tratativas das divergências do mês, bem como avaliar e controlar horas extras, visando contribuir para o correto fechamento da folha de pagamento do setor
  • Acompanhar e verificar o uso e estado de conservação de aparelhos e equipamentos do setor, identificando e comunicando aos setores responsáveis necessidades de manutenção e reparo, visando garantir as condições de uso e conservação
  • Avaliar relatórios de custos emitidos pelo setor de Contabilidade, visando verificar se os lançamentos são compatíveis com o efetivamente gasto
  • Elaborar planilha de indicadores de qualidade do setor, bem como acompanhar os mesmos, visando aprimorar a qualidade, maximizar a produtividade e o nível de satisfação dos clientes internos, bem como reduzir custos

Junte-se ao Grupo CPFL e Potencialize Sua Carreira!

Tecnico Analise Projetos I

Vaga exclusiva para pessoa com deficiência (PCD) ou Reabilitado(a) do INSS

Onde você vai atuar: São Leopoldo/RS

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial

Empresa: RGE – Uma empresa do Grupo CPFL Energia

  • Necessária formação técnica completa em: eletrotécnica, eletroeletrônica, eletromecânica, mecatrônica, eletrônica e automação industrial;

  • Necessário ser pessoa com deficiência (PCD) ou reabilitado(a) do INSS.

O seu dia a dia:

Desempenhar tarefas administrativas padronizadas de análise, elaboração de projetos e orçamentos de redes de distribuição de energia elétrica de baixa complexidade, através dos sistemas corporativos GISD e SAP, técnica e economicamente viáveis buscando equilíbrio entre qualidade x custo dentro dos prazos e cronogramas definidos pela Empresa, bem como observar aspectos de segurança, ambientais, normas, padrões e demais procedimentos e legislação vigente. Atividades realizadas somente em ambiente administrativo. Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar os projetos, obedecendo as normas e padrões da empresa, mantendo um equilíbrio entre qualidade, custo e prazo.
  • Analisar e Elaborar projetos e orçamentos de baixa complexidade visando o atendimento dos prazos regulados e cronogramas definidos pela Empresa.
  • Analisar, através dos sistemas digitais GISD e SAP, as solicitações de clientes externos e internos visando o atendimento de padrões técnicos da empresa e dos prazos definidos.
  • Realizar pré-análise das notas dos planos de obras de menor grau de complexidade.

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade);
  • Wellhub;
  • Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social).

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções emgeração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

title: TÉCNICO I - CAMPINAS/SP
description:
Descrição da vaga

Realizar os atendimentos técnicos compreendendo o diagnóstico, reparo troca de peças e conservação dos produtos operados pela empresa em sua área de atuação, utilizando os conhecimentos, sistemas e ferramentas disponibilizados pela organização, com vistas ao pronto reestabelecimento do serviço e o atingimento do nível de serviço requerido.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Tático-Operacional: efetuar os atendimentos designados pelos sistemas de gestão de tickets e pela equipe de retaguarda, utilizando os conhecimentos e ferramentas disponibilizadas pela empresa, de modo a restabelecer o serviço na primeira visita, evitando as reincidências em prol da qualidade e do atingimento dos níveis de serviço acordados.

Diagnóstico Técnico e troca de peças: determinar as causas dos defeitos valendo-se do conhecimento técnico e das ferramentas disponibilizadas pela empresa, efetuar a troca das peças necessárias ao reestabelecimento do serviço visando o pronto atendimento às necessidades do cliente.

Ativação: atuar no processo de ativação de novos serviços inspecionando a qualidade das instalações, efetuando a habilitação dos equipamentos, testando e tomando ações para garantir o bom funcionamento do produto, da infraestrutura e demais dispositivos que compõem o ponto.

Manutenção: uma vez ativado o serviço, atuar na manutenção, conservação e reparo dos equipamentos que o compõem e da infraestrutura associada, através de diagnostico, retirada de defeitos, reposição de insumos e troca de consumíveis. Realizar os testes que assegurem o correto funcionamento dos elementos em manutenção. Reparo/troca dos componentes intra e extra cofre que apresentarem defeito do equipamento, identificado através de conhecimento técnico.

Vistoria,Conservação e Limpeza: vistoriar e manter limpos e bem conservados os equipamentos e demais dispositivos que compõem o ponto. Sinalizar as necessidades de pintura, troca de elementos, sinalização e demais componentes cuja manutenção não possa ser feita diretamente.

Instalação e Testes de Dispositivos de Segurança: realizar testes periódicos e de funcionamento dos dispositivos de segurança que compõem o produto. Quando necessário, efetuar a instalação de novos dispositivos de segurança conforme determinações específicas da área competente.

title: Senior Staff / Principal Engineer - Digital Ecosystem
description:
Opportunity

We are hiring a Senior Staff or Principal Engineer to support driving the technical vision and execution for Nubank’s Digital Ecosystem division, with initial focus on NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance. This is a division-level leadership role: you will work with exceptional engineers (including staff engineers), lead cross-org architectural decisions, negotiate trade-offs with product/finance/legal, and enable scalable delivery of high-impact products (checkout & wallet, advertiser platform and benefits hub, and 1-click insurance products).

Vision and contribution

2026's Vision And (how This Role Contributes). In 2026 we will transform the Digital Ecosystem into a place where customers discover advantages, pay effortlessly and feel protected, and where merchants grow through data-driven integrated partnerships. Our priorities are: (1) elevating app quality, (2) deepening customer engagement with contextual and personalized experiences, (3) making Nubank the preferred payments partner and growth engine for merchants, and (4) ensuring scalable, compliant, and financially healthy foundations. This role will own the technical plan to deliver that vision across NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance.

  • NuPay scales to become the de facto checkout and wallet for Nubank customers (TPV ×2 by Dec/26; wallet >3M MAU).
  • Ads & Rewards delivers the Advantages Tab, a performant advertiser platform and Ads POC with merchants, and drives material ecosystem revenue.
  • Insurance launches and scales high-quality one-click complements (Mobile Insurance Relaunch, Pix Protegido evolution), while maintaining aggressive SLOs, strong observability, controlled TCO and an elevated engineering culture.
Core Responsibilities
  • Support defining the division’s technical end-state (2–3 years): architecture, shard/partition strategy, migration path (one‑stack) and explicit trade-offs (cost × latency × availability).
  • Co-own availability and performance: set SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, runbooks, incident playbooks and an observability strategy that supports merchants with strict SLAs.
  • Support Ads & Rewards platform design: advertiser platform (audience & campaign management), decision/bidding service, real-time vs batch decisioning, measurement & attribution (ROAS/incrementality), and minimise impact on app UX.
  • Drive NuPay ↔ Ads integration for aspirational purchases: real-time underwriting, multi-source funding, take-rate modelling, card-on-file / wallet flows and onboarding for flagship merchants.
  • Enable Insurance delivery: technical enablement for one-click products, partner integration and governance (e.g., Chubb), migration to subscription/billing platform where applicable, and app quality improvements (TTFD, dashboards, NPS).
  • Support one-stack discovery and phased migration: balance platformization with pragmatic delivery and tech-debt management to avoid blocking growth.
  • Catalyse product quality culture: introduce and operationalize Product Quality Reviews, drive app excellence rituals, and ensure UX/technical quality are considered across the product lifecycle.
  • Mentor and grow engineering leaders and staff engineers; run RFCs, tech talks and post-mortems; design career paths and enable managers to deliver cross-BU initiatives.
  • Represent the division in cross-org negotiations and external partner discussions (merchants, partners, regulators), aligning stakeholders and escalating risks proactively.
  • Track and report technical impact against business metrics and engineering health indicators.
Key business & engineering metrics you will influence
  • NuPay: TPV growth (2× by Dec/26), wallet MAU (>3M), share-of-checkout (SoC), p99 latency and availability for merchant traffic.
  • Ads & Rewards: ad revenue targets (material ecosystem revenue), ROAS / iROAS / incrementality, CTR, Ads POC results (≥2 merchants), Advantages Tab / Shelves Platform launch.
  • Insurance: one-click complements GWP target (R$493M EOY), product NPS (>60 targets), churn reduction via billing/tolerance changes.
  • Engineering health: Engineering Stability Index (ESI), App Quality Score, incident frequency/severity, time to integrate new partners.
Challenges And Opportunities (what You’ll Own)
  • World-class app quality & Magic App MVP: raise engineering and product expectations, and deliver first-layer Magic App experiences (Advantages Tab, widgets, contextual flows such as AIPB).
  • Real-time decisioning and aspirational financing: enable low-latency ads decisioning and NuPay real-time underwriting for extended financing while preserving app performance.
  • One-click Insurance at scale: deliver MIR (no IMEI) and Pix Protegido evolution, dedicating energy to one-click complements and partnering with Chubb while retaining monitoring/control.
  • Capture offline transactions: accelerate NuPay NFC wallet adoption as an offensive play to reach ~3M MAU and increase offline SoC.
  • Platform & compliance foundations: complete SPB integration, advance One-Stack Project, meet Magic App and regulatory mandates, and ensure resilient, cost-efficient infra.
What You’ll Find In The Team
  • High-calibre engineers, including staff engineers and experienced engineering managers.
  • Complex, high-impact problems at scale: large merchant integrations, real-time decisioning, strict SLOs and multi-partner dependencies.
  • Autonomy to shape architecture, product quality rituals and the division roadmap, plus the responsibility to align delivery across product, infra, legal and commercial stakeholders.
What You’ll Navigate
  • Heavy cross-BU dependencies (Global Platforms, Nubank+, UV, Marketing) requiring strong stakeholder orchestration.
  • Regulatory changes (SPB/BCB) that may force re-architecture or open-scheme decisions.
  • Dependence on third-party vendors (wallet SDKs, insurance partners) and partner infra limitations.
  • Balancing rapid commercialization and monetization with fraud/credit loss control and sustainable unit economics.
  • Trade-offs between accelerating one-stack migration and accepting short-term technical debt to preserve delivery velocity.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Delegar e coordenar o desenvolvimento das atividades da Auditoria Interna e CAD, visando garantir a eficácia do trabalho realizado
  • Colaborar com os responsáveis dos diversos setores de enfermagem na resolução de problemas técnicos e administrativos referentes aos prontuários médicos, contas hospitalares e processos de trabalho assistenciais.

  • Identificar as não conformidades dos processos de trabalho dos setores assistenciais e administrativos
  • Acompanhar as legislações e atualizações referentes aos convênios e inerentes à área de atuação.

Responder pelo fechamento do cartão ponto, regularizar as tratativas das divergências do mês, bem como avaliar e controlar horas extras, visando contribuir para o correto fechamento da folha de pagamento do setor.

  • Elaborar planilha de indicadores de qualidade do setor, bem como acompanhar os mesmos, visando aprimorar a qualidade, maximizar a produtividade e o nível de satisfação dos clientes internos, bem como reduzir custos.

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines,regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimentoprático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);

Sólida experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL e práticas de otimização de consultas. Experiência com serviços cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e containers (Docker, Kubernetes). Familiaridade com arquiteturas de sistemas, pipelines de dados e boas práticas de integração de APIs (REST, GraphQL). Diferenciais: Experiência com AI Generativa e modelos LLMs (ex.: GPT, BERT). Experiência em com Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes ou ferramentas como Azure Container Apps (ou relativas). Vivência em ambientes com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban). Experiência colaborando em projetos com arquitetos de soluções ou times comerciais.

title: Clinical Study Manager
description: Job Summary The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia's headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.Education and Experience Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a 'can-do' attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).. Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

increased automation coverage and reduced toil. Faster time to provision and higher first success rate for self-service requests. SLO attainment for AI endpoints and messaging services;
reduced alert noise viaimproved observability (New Relic/Azure Monitor). What You Will Bring Proven experience managing SRE/platform/infrastructure teams delivering production-critical services. Deep familiarity with Azure and the team stack: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB;
Redis;
messaging systems such as CloudAMQP/RabbitMQ, Kafka, Event Hubs, and Service Bus. Strong reliability fundamentals: SLOs/SLIs, incident and problem management, capacity, DR/BCP, performance tuning. Solid automation background: IaC (Terraform/Crossplane), CI/CD (Azure DevOps), GitOps, policyascode, secrets and identity, RBAC. Track record of building selfservice platforms and reducing toil. Excellent crossfunctional leadership with product, security, and compliance partners. Experience operating Azure AI services in production (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search). Observability experience with New Relic, Azure Monitor, and OpenTelemetry. What You’ll Need Advanced skills in English Experience with AI-assisted operations and troubleshooting. Observability expertise (Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry). Database performance engineering and query optimization. security and reliability are nonnegotiable. Blameless postmortems, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes. title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Technical Implementation Specialist
description: Why Kodif? At Kodif, we’re transforming how customers interact with eCommerce brands. From shopping to support to retention, we’re building agentic AI systems that make every website interaction personalized, instant, and human-like — redefining the modern customer journey. Highlights: Our team comes from Uber, Meta, Stanford, and Walmart. Our CTO built Uber’s customer support platform. We’re backed by Bling Capital, SNR (Kevin Mahaffey), and Village Global (backed by Jeff Bezos, Bill Gates, and Reid Hoffman), with $9M raised to date. We’re trusted by leading eCommerce brands like Dollar Shave Club, Liquid I.V., Trust Wallet, and Alma. Our Culture & Values: At Kodif, our values guide how we work, what we build, and how we grow together: Make It Simple ✔️ – Build systems that are clear, reliable, and scalable. Superhuman Speed ⚡️ – Move fast and own the outcome — design, build, and deploy in days, not weeks. Extreme Ownership – Take end-to-end responsibility for delivering impact, not just features. Customer Crazy – We obsess over creating delightful, human-like AI experiences for our customers. Two Steps Ahead – Anticipate issues before they surface. Design for the future. Row Together – Collaborate, communicate, and ship together — success at Kodif is a team sport. Position Overview: The Technical Implementation Specialist focuses on implementation of AI automation workflows, technical troubleshooting, product behavior analysis, and technical issue resolution. This role combines proactive customer management with technical troubleshooting, enabling Kodif’s customers to maximize the value of our platform. The Implementation Specialist will work cross-functionally to resolve issues, identify risks, and help customers succeed with the Kodif platform. Responsibilities: Partner with customers to align product adoption strategies with business goals. Monitor customer communication channels to identify issues, resolve them, and escalate to Tier 2 technical support when needed. Identify and mitigate risks related to usage, adoption, or critical defects by creating and executing targeted action plans. Initiate and manage escalation processes, coordinating communication between customers and internal teams. Support post-mortem analyses for escalations or major incidents. Relay customer feedback to product and engineering to influence roadmap priorities. Address concerns early to reduce churn risk and support long-term retention. Support internal teams with technical insights and root-cause analysis. Contribute to documentation, troubleshooting guides, and product improvements. Requirements: Experience in Support, Implementation, or Customer Success (preferably in AI or CX SaaS). Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills (no coding required). Strong technical acumen and ability to explain complex concepts clearly. Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of building trust and advocating for customers. Experience with ticketing systems, Slack-based support, or similar communication tools. Experience with LLM prompting. Ability to read and interpret JSON (e.G., identify failed integration calls and relevant fields). Nice to have: Ability to interpret SQL-level data and database-driven summaries (light query writing may be required). Ability to read Python-related error messages and escalate appropriately (no direct coding required). Compensation & Benefits: Competitive salary based on location and work experience. Opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, product, and customer experience with real business impact. Opportunity to build one of the most impactful AI systems in eCommerce. To be considered, please complete this short application form (2–3 minutes): and then apply here as well.

title: Database Administrator
description: As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication. Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT. Responsibilities: Creates and maintains all databases required for development, testing, pre-prod and production usage. Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments. Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database. Plan, configure Disaster Recovery environment using Data Guard, and perform Disaster Recovery test. Controls migration of programs, database changes, reference data changes through the development life cycle Implement operational automation using Ansible and shell scripting. Perform complex performance turning and optimization for operational efficiency. Utilizing tuning utilities and reports such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQLT, SQL Tuning Advisor, SQL tracing and analysis, and database event tracing. Perform frequent database refreshes and migrations. Enforces and maintains database constraints to ensure integrity of the database. Administers all database objects, including tables, clusters, indexes, views, sequences, packages and procedures. Discover and implement performance and uptime improvement strategies. Assists with impact analysis of any changes made to the database objects. Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers. Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities. Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience. A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle. 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments. Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture. Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool. Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment. Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing. Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s) Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable. Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios. A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.

Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design. Hands-on experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform;
ability to collaborateeffectively with development teams on implementation. Proficiency in using CRO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, heatmap tools, and experimentation platforms. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex data sets, experiment results, and performance reports. Ability to present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams and leadership. Ability to solve practical problems and apply structured experimentation methodology in ambiguous situations. Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data to form clear, testable hypotheses. Ability to calculate and interpret key metrics such as conversion rates, statistical significance, and revenue metrics. Education and/or experience Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, or equivalent experience as a CRO specialist or analyst in e-commerce. 3–5 years of experience managing a CRO program or cross-functional optimization team. Collaboration: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others. Self-Development: Actively seeking growth opportunities. Strategic Thinking: Identifying opportunities and adapting to trends. Technical Proficiency & Problem Solving: Using tools and data to drive solutions. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills. Results-driven: Focused on measurable, data-driven outcomes. Benefits A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance. The opportunity to drive measurable revenue growth by optimizing user experience and conversion performance. Two weeks of paid vacation per year. 10 paid days for local holidays. *Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Ai Quality Analyst (Portuguese)
description: Company Description MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specialises in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead. With expertise in Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimisation, MillionLogics offers tailored services with a focus on client success. Supported by a team of over 50 AI & Oracle experts, MillionLogics combines cutting-edge technology with a commitment to delivering impactful outcomes. Learn more about our services on our website. Role Overview: As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Offer Details: Pay: US$ 1500 per month (Net/take-home) Contract Duration: 12 months Number of Open Positions: 20 Key Qualifications Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic\ "overnarrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying\ "Debug Info\" from the modelto confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.G., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 30 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week) Engagement type: Contractor Evaluation Process - Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. How to Apply? Please send us your updated CV to with job ID: 62136 as your email subject.

title: Senior Web Manager
description: About the Role: We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.Com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team. You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals. Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience. Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators. Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful. Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads. Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope. What We’re Looking For: Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful. Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components. SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager. Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution. Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience. Why Join Us: This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

title: Account Executive
description: A AutoZone é a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo! Empresa Americana, estamos em plena expansão no Brasil, com mais de 156 lojas no país. A AutoZone inaugurou sua primeira loja AutoZone do Brasil na cidade de Sorocaba em setembro de 2012. Nossa mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e compromisso com Ir Além definem quem somos, tanto para nossos clientes quanto para os AutoZoners. Trabalhar na AutoZone significa fazer parte de uma equipe que valoriza a dedicação, o trabalho em equipe e o crescimento. Esteja você ajudando clientes ou construindo sua carreira, fornecemos ferramentas e suporte para ajudá-lo a ter sucesso e impulsionar seu futuro. Com mais de 7.000 lojas em operação e presença consolidada em diversos países, a AutoZone é uma referência global no setor de autopeças e acessórios automotivos. No Brasil, seguimos em ritmo acelerado de expansão, com operações em sete estados: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Bahia, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás. Descrição do Cargo O profissional será responsável pela gestão de ponta a ponta dos processos de importação e reposição de estoque junto a fornecedores internacionais. Seu principal objetivo é garantir a disponibilidade de produtos no Centro de Distribuição e lojas, otimizando o fluxo logístico e a ocupação de contêineres. Atuará na interface estratégica entre parceiros de Trading, Global Sourcing e áreas internas da AutoZone, assegurando a conformidade aduaneira, fiscal e documental, além de desenvolver indicadores (KPIs) focados em melhoria contínua e redução de custos. Responsabilidades Realizar a colocação e o controle de pedidos de reposição com fornecedores chineses, analisando níveis de inventário do CD e lojas. Garantir a melhor ocupação possível dos contêineres, otimizando custos e prazos logísticos. Elaborar e controlar a documentação necessária de importação, incluindo invoices e packing lists, bem como coleta de assinaturas. Solicitar a classificação fiscal junto à consultoria terceirizada e providenciar todas as informações necessárias para o processo. Encaminhar documentação para a área de Trading, avaliando a necessidade de tratamento administrativo. Desenvolver, implementar e assegurar o cumprimento dos Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (SOPs) junto aos fornecedores. Conduzir análises de causa raiz e liderar ações corretivas para evitar recorrência de desvios operacionais. Garantir a integridade e atualização da base de dados aduaneiros dos produtos importados. Realizar follow-up dos processos de importação e atuar na intermediação de comunicação em novos projetos com Global Sourcing e parceiros. Qualificações Ensino superior completo em Comércio Exterior, Logística, Engenharia de Produção, Relações Internacionais ou Administração. Conhecimentos no Pacote Office. Conhecimento em Power BI será considerado diferencial. Inglês em nível avançado. Informações Adicionais Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido - PaulÍnia/SP Tipo de contrato: CLT. Benefícios: Assistência médica com participação, assistência odontológica, seguro de vida, vale-refeição, convênio em academias, programa de apoio ao AutoZoner e desconto de 20% em produtos nas lojas AutoZone. Valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos em ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.

title: Ai Project Manager
description: A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa referência em soluções de dados e analytics na busca por um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Dados. Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na condução de iniciativas end-to-end — desde a fase de discovery até o go-live — atuando como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio. O desafio envolve liderar projetos complexos de dados, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, dentro do prazo e alinhadas aos objetivos da organização. Buscamos um perfil que una forte experiência em gestão de projetos com repertório técnico em dados, capaz de navegar com autonomia entre stakeholders, engenharia e decisões de arquitetura. Principais responsabilidades Liderar projetos de dados de média e alta complexidade (data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, BI, migração de dados, entre outros). Definir e gerenciar escopo, cronograma, orçamento, recursos e riscos. Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (dailies, sprints, retrospectivas) e adaptar frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, híbrido) conforme o contexto. Atuar como interface entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, traduzindo demandas em planos de execução claros. Monitorar KPIs de projeto (velocity, burn-down, progresso) e comunicar status para diferentes níveis da organização. Antecipar riscos, dependências e gargalos, propondo planos de mitigação. Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros envolvidos nas entregas. Garantir documentação estruturada de processos, decisões e aprendizados. Impulsionar melhoria contínua nas práticas de gestão de projetos da área de dados. Requisitos Experiência consolidada (5+ anos) em gestão de projetos de tecnologia, sendo ao menos 2 anos em projetos de dados ou analytics. Conhecimento prático do ecossistema de dados: data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, modelagem de dados e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau ou similares). Domínio de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK/Waterfall), com flexibilidade de aplicação. Experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday, Asana ou similares). Forte habilidade de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação executiva. Capacidade de interpretar documentação técnica (arquitetura, modelos de dados, integrações). Inglês fluente (interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais). Diferenciais Background técnico prévio (Data Analyst, Data Engineer ou BI Developer). Experiência com cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP). Uso de soluções de IA como aceleradores de entrega. Conhecimento em SQL para validações básicas. Vivência com change management em contextos data-driven. Conhecimento em governança de dados (ex: DAMA-DMBOK). Certificações (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM, SAFe ou similares). Experiência com gestão de portfólio e priorização estratégica.

title: Programmatic Engineer
description: About Joveo: Every company says they're\ "AI-first.\" We actually are.Joveo's recruitment advertising platform processes millions of hiring decisions through machine learning, real-time bidding, and predictive analytics — helping the world's largest employers find the right people, faster and fairer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All hiring decisions are made solely on the basis of qualifications, skills, and demonstrated ability. If your dream job is one that doesn't fit neatly into a job title — apply. Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L. Role Overview: We are looking for highly detail-oriented Video Data Annotators to support cutting-edge AI/ML initiatives focused on first-person (egocentric) video understanding. In this role, you will analyze video clips and answer questions based strictly on what is visually observable at a specific moment in time. Your work will directly contribute to training and improving advanced vision-language models. This is a precision-driven role that requires strong observational skills, disciplined thinking, and the ability to follow strict guidelines. This role is perfect for someone who loves data, automation, clean systems, and turning complex workflows into simple, scalable processes. You will work closely with sales, marketing, customer success, and leadership to ensure that our CRM is structured, automated, and delivering actionable insights that drive revenue growth.
